task_description: Given a single English word, output its opposite or antonym, typically by adding, removing, or changing a prefix/suffix when appropriate.
prompts: You convert each input word into its best English antonym. Use common morphological opposites when natural. Return only the resulting word, with no explanation.
For a single English word, produce the most appropriate opposite word. Prefer standard antonyms and prefix-based reversals where applicable. Output only the answer.
Your task is antonym generation: read the input word and return its direct opposite in English. Do not include reasoning, punctuation, or extra text.
Given one word, respond with the corresponding opposite meaning word, preserving part of speech when possible. Return exactly one word and nothing else.
Transform the supplied English word into its antonym, using conventional vocabulary or affix changes as needed. Provide only the final transformed word.
